title: Training Note — Prompt-Claim Bonus on Ridgeline Special Order Services Delay Credits
content:
A customer who takes the delay credit soon after the item was handed over earns a prompt bonus on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent.

**Clause.** The prompt bonus depends on the calendar days from the completed date to today: no more than 7 days gives a prompt bonus of 1; more than 7 days and no more than 30 days gives 0.5; otherwise, or while the item has not been handed over, it is 0.

The prompt bonus is a number of percentage points added to the percentage of the credit base at which the delay credit is figured.

## Questions answered by the clause

**Which date starts the count?** The completed date — the date the item was picked up or delivered.

**What if the item is still at the store or with the vendor?** The bonus is 0 while the item has not been handed over.

## Day bands

| Calendar days from the completed date to today | Prompt bonus (points) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 1 |
| 8 to 30 | 0.5 |
| 31 or more | 0 |
| not handed over | 0 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical today of 20 June)

| Completed date | Days | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 13 June | 7 | 1 |
| 12 June | 8 | 0.5 |
| 21 May | 30 | 0.5 |
| 20 May | 31 | 0 |
